headline: Jingzhou's Joyson Safety Hit by Ransomware, Halts Production, Data Stolen
body: Joyson Safety Systems' Jingzhou facility, previously known as Takata (Jingzhou), has been struck by a ransomware attack. With operations disrupted, the company warns that vital business documents may have been compromised. Teams are working diligently to bring systems back online in a phased manner.
